## Changes / 改了什么

Describe the user-visible change and the reason. Link the Issue if applicable.

## Verification / 如何检查

State the checks actually run and their results. Note anything not tested; use N/A for a documentation-only change where appropriate.

## Scientific scope and rights / 科学事实与素材

- [ ] If scientific definitions, units, comparisons or claims change, give the primary source / official guidance and applicable conditions. Otherwise state N/A.
- [ ] All included data, images and code may be shared under their stated licenses; no credentials or private research material are included.
- [ ] Existing input values, evidence states and untested limitations remain visible.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the existing contribution rules.
